d: After the October 7 Hamas attacks, Israel launched one of the most extensive manhunts in modern warfare. A covert task force known as NILI was reportedly created to identify, track and eliminate every person linked to the attacks, from Hamas commanders to alleged hostage captors. Using facial recognition technology, cellphone tracking, intercepted communications and social media videos, Israeli intelligence agencies built a massive targeting network that continues to operate even after ceasefire efforts in Gaza.
